Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, cg As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = 52
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 2
        ch.ChartType = 53
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 3
        ch.ChartType = 57
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 4
        ch.ChartType = 58
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 5
        ch.ChartType = 59
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 6
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 7
        ch.ChartType = 63
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 8
        ch.ChartType = 64
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = 65
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 10
        ch.ChartType = 66
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 11
        ch.ChartType = 67
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 12
        ch.ChartType = 5
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 13
        ch.ChartType = -4120
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 14
        ch.ChartType = -4169
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 15
        ch.ChartType = 1
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 16
        ch.ChartType = 76
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 17
        ch.ChartType = 77
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
    Case 18
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
        cg.HasDropLines = True
    Case 19
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
        cg.HasHiLoLines = True
    Case 20
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
        cg.HasUpDownBars = True
    Case 21
        ch.ChartType = 52
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
        cg.HasSeriesLines = True
    Case 22
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
        cg.HasDropLines = True: cg.DropLines.Delete
    Case 23
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set cg = ch.ChartGroups(1)
        cg.HasUpDownBars = True: cg.UpBars.Delete
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.Elevation
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.Rotation
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.Perspective
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.RightAngleAxes
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.DepthPercent
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.HeightPercent
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.GapDepth
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.AutoScaling
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.BarShape
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.ChartStyle
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.ChartColor
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.CategoryLabelLevel
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.SeriesNameLevel
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & cg.DropLines.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(cg.DropLines.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & cg.HiLoLines.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & cg.UpBars.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & cg.DownBars.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(cg.UpBars.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & cg.SeriesLines.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(cg.SeriesLines.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & cg.HasDropLines
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & cg.HasUpDownBars
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = "ok " & Mid(s, 2)
Closed:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Closed
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 23
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
